headlines.title: Oakley man in custody after Thanksgiving shooting kills wife, injures stepdaughter
headlines.description: HISTORY IS ALL AROUND… when you’re toodling around the Golden State, but it is in Gold Country that you really feel like you might slip through a portal to the not-so-distant past. The historic plaques, the hilltop cemeteries, the boardwalks that still creak and the saloon doors that swing… it is an area that can easily exist in a few centuries within a single moment. And when that moment occurs in November or December, and you’re calling upon a community in the Sierra foothills, you just might encounter a Victorian caroler, or detect the scent of chestnuts, or stroll by an authentic brass band. Large though it is, and certainly varied, the lengthy stretch of Gold County has something of a lovely lock on presenting a sepia-toned expression of the holidays. Some revelries are coming up, with one of the biggest, Victorian Christmas in Nevada City, returning to beautiful Broad Street for a handful of crisp December afternoons and nights. SUNDAY, DEC. 6… is the first of five 2026 outings for the event, which will mark its 50th anniversary in just a couple of years. Artisans, bands, snacks that might be modern or straight out of the 18th century, and a general glow that feels like a throwback add allure to the popular event. So popular is this event that planning how you’ll arrive, and where you’ll park or stay the night, is essential before heading to the hilly and handsome hamlet. Just a jump and a skip from Nevada City, give or take, is gorgeous Grass Valley, the longtime home of Cornish Christmas. And we do mean “longtime,” for the revelry is heading into its 58th go-around this year. There are four Fridays on the schedule, with the first landing at the end of November. Holiday happenings will flower, like an attractive amaryllis, throughout Gold Country, but if you head further south, to Sonora, you’ll encounter a bevy of to-dos. Christmas Town Sonora is the ho-ho-handle that the group of events happens under, with a Nov. 27 Christmas parade, Santa visits, and a Celtic concert coming right up.
